items.evidence: Log shows 5 uL Q5 2x mix into all 96 wells first (lines 2-129), then 4 uL primer pair, then 1 uL template (e.g. lines 900-901), giving a 10 uL reaction with master mix before template.
Log shows primer_plate and colony_plate well X going to pcr_plate well X for all A1-H12 in column order, with no skips or repeats.
One tip is used for master mix into empty wells (lines 1-130), then a fresh tip is picked up and dropped for every primer pair and every colony template through line 1858.
The code has protocol.comment calls for sealing the plate and for a program of 98C 3 min, 30 cycles of 98C 10 s, 60C 20 s and 72C 45 s, then 72C 2 min and a 4C hold, which suits Q5.

The 10 uL reaction with 1 uL template and master mix before template follows the paper's OT-2 workflow, and the 4 uL primer pair is a flagged adaptation to the per-colony primer plate with accurate comments.

judge.summary: The simulator log shows a 10 uL Q5 colony PCR set up correctly across all 96 wells: master mix first, then primer pair, then template, each in matching wells with fresh tips. Sealing and a suitable Q5 thermocycling program are recorded as comments, and the adaptations are stated as such.
